newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 21.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 21.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones fell 57.40 points to 6,820.28. PLDT's ADR rose $0 3/8 to $57 7/8.
* The peso closed unchanged at 26.333 to the dollar.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index fell 6.06 points to 3,206.67.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average was unchanged at 10.03125 percent.
* Media giant ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp has reached a compromise with advertisers over the increase in its primetime rates to a range of 18.6 to 21 percent, an advertisers association says.
* Fortune Cement Corp posts a 154 percent increase in net income to 516.9 million pesos from 203.4 million posted in 1995.
* A Soriano Corp major stockholders, brothers Andres and Carlos, say their disagreements are "just normal disagreements among family members on how to run the business".
* Metro Pacific Corp says it has sold its entire stake in Philippine Cocoa Corp to Nestle Philippines Inc.

* Food and beverage giant Sna Miguel Corp and Solid Bank Corp are interested in buying into the trading arm subsidiary of the Philippine International Trading Corp, PITC president Jose Yulo says. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
